question: Simulate a glucose batch for CEN.PK113-7D from the extracted kinetics and compare the predicted yield with the Yeast9 ceiling.

claims.text: Maximum ethanol yield on glucose for Saccharomyces cerevisiae S288C under the Yeast9 genome-scale network, computed by flux balance analysis as a ceiling with no time axis and no vessel.
Overall ethanol yield on glucose for CEN.PK113-7D reported in a fed-batch study of high-ethanol performance and glycerol formation.
Overall ethanol yield on glucose for CEN.PK113-7D reported in a study of the metabolic cost of lowering glycerol formation under anaerobic conditions.

The glucose-to-ethanol yields recorded for CEN.PK113-7D sit below the Yeast9 flux-balance ceiling for glucose, so the ceiling is not reached by any of these measurements; the comparison is a record-to-ceiling reading, not a simulated batch yield.

No ethanol-lipid kinetic parameter, Monod half-saturation constant, or maximum product concentration for CEN.PK113-7D on glucose is on file, so no batch simulation of this strain could be bound from records.

gaps: The glucose batch simulation for CEN.PK113-7D did not run. The batch_v1 family refused because five parameters wait: ks (monod_ks for this strain on glucose, none bound), alpha (ethanol_lp_alpha, none bound), p_max (ethanol_max_conc, none bound), x0 (cells at the start) and p0 (product at the start), which need a fit, a kept simulation, or a named person's assumption typed in fermOS → Simulate. I did not supply any of them, so no simulated yield exists to compare.
No fermOS kinetic fit or forecast exists for CEN.PK113-7D, so the extracted kinetics cannot bind through a fit. A person would need to fit a deposited batch run of this strain on glucose.

The three yield records (Q18, Q9, Q7) are unverified extractor candidates with no fermentation conditions recorded (conditions null), and the Q18 and Q9 growth-rate records do not state whether they describe the parental strain; they cannot be used as a verified batch kinetic set until a person reviews them.

The Yeast9 ceiling is for S288C, not CEN.PK113-7D: no genome-scale model of CEN.PK113-7D is on the geneOS shelf. The ceiling carries no time axis or vessel, so it is a theoretical maximum rather than a batch prediction.
Measured yields in the records come from different designs (fed-batch and anaerobic work, with the ALE study's conditions unrecorded), so none is a glucose batch yield under matched conditions.
I wrote nothing to any module; the refused simulation left no artifact.
